## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (it becomes the squash commit), e.g. `feat: add login page object`
- [ ] `npm run build` and `dotnet build E2eStarter.sln` pass
- [ ] `scripts/run-e2e.sh` passes locally
- [ ] Documentation is updated where behaviour changed
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data are committed
